By working together with local leaders & the health care community, we've clawed back $775,000 of our federal tax dollars from Washington to North Jersey — for a new lifesaving, cutting-edge CT scanner for @HMHNewJersey University Medical Center's new ICU.
https://t.co/1HF2Otvye5

Roger is one of our #NJ5HometownHeroes for always taking care of his community! He’s President of the Ramsey Seniors group where he has found instructors to add more senior exercise classes. He’s also a volunteer member of @RamseyAlliance, which works to reduce substance abuse. https://t.co/8H8DfhWtfX

Today is #SchoolLunchHeroDay!

Thank you to the hardworking school nutrition professionals and cafeteria staff for making sure our students eat well and learn. 

Our children are rockets ready to take off, but they won’t reach their dreams without fuel in the tank.

I’m also working with towns across the Fifth District to claw back even more of our own tax dollars to help improve their water treatment facilities, protect our families, and make life more affordable.

As of March 2021, of the more than 200,000 veterans who were signed up for the VA’s burn pit registry — 70% of claims had been denied.

Many are still sick and too many have already died.

This new investment will help improve research, treatment, and help the VA process claims.

The two pieces of bipartisan legislation I announced today will help us understand exactly where we’re seeing a spike in ticks and the types of ticks our families are facing, spread awareness to keep our communities safe, and boost investment in R&D for Lyme disease treatment.

I'm proud to have clawed back $2.8M from Washington & away from Moocher States to invest in a new water treatment facility to serve +62K people in Ridgewood, Glen Rock, Midland Park, & Wyckoff.

Today, we celebrated the groundbreaking of @ridgewood_water’s Ravine Treatment Plant! https://t.co/SVP3sHkuOS

We celebrated the groundbreaking of a new water treatment facility made possible by clawing $2.8M in the tax dollars we sent to Washington back to NJ and away from the Moocher States to invest in this project, and lower the tax burden on families.
https://t.co/wM3XlSo8Xt

Working with our tireless mayors and councils, we’ve clawed a $2.8M investment back from Washington to invest in a new water treatment facility that will serve +62K people in Ridgewood, Glen Rock, Midland Park, & Wyckoff!
https://t.co/ahhbnO6bDM

I'm proud to have clawed back $2.8M from Washington & away from Moocher States to NJ for a new water treatment facility.
 
Once complete, it will deliver safe drinking water to 60k+ residents in North Jersey & help lower the tax burden on families!
https://t.co/Xn4lOEmqZ6

Nearly 167K women, children, and infants in Jersey — and close to 7M across the country — are at risk of losing nutrition assistance during a shutdown.

The @ProbSolveCaucus put forth a bipartisan plan to stop a shutdown and help hard-working families. https://t.co/Uq8OFTVCTg

Second, I’m also introducing the bipartisan HELP for Veterans Act to boost investments in nonprofits that help our vets in NJ & prevent delays when veterans need mental health support & treatment.

Far too many veterans are placed on waitlists, this legislation will help fix that

In the House, @RepLCD & I introduced the bipartisan SNAP Nutrition Security Act of 2023. @SenBooker & @SenMarcoRubio introduced it in the Senate.

Our bill helps us understand food affordability & get healthier foods to SNAP recipients, including millions of children & seniors.

In Jersey, nearly 200K children & 800K+ people face hunger, but far-right extremists want to cut anti-hunger nutrition programs for babies, children, & families in need.

We need to combat hunger here in NJ and across our nation, not only on Giving Tuesday, but every day.

We’re watching in real-time as far-right extremists conduct a war on women’s healthcare and the disastrous effects it’s had on women across the nation.
 
Watch @ABC7 to learn about my new action to protect against ongoing threats to IVF ⬇️
https://t.co/wOFD4LWjdJ

We must invest in targeted research & public awareness to fund cures and treatment for the thousands of women in Jersey and the US who have been diagnosed with rare diseases.

My new SEARCH Act will do just that.

Learn more:
https://t.co/O5vQUzLfow

We must invest in targeted research & public awareness to fund cures and treatment for the thousands of women in Jersey and the US who have been diagnosed with rare diseases.
 
My new SEARCH Act will help combat this and find treatments & cures.
https://t.co/MfkPYc5SaC

The Houthis are torturing and executing members of the LGBTQ+ community simply because of who they love.
 
The @UN's delay in condemning their horrific actions endangers the lives of LGBTQ+ people around the world.
https://t.co/uw9Y20NDVl

May is National #MentalHealthAwarenessMonth.

This month, we honor those living with mental health conditions & recommit ourselves to investing in mental health research, treatment, & education.

If you’re struggling with your mental health, please know that you are not alone. https://t.co/aL9WMWqbEA

Thank you to @njssahq for stopping by my DC office to discuss safe patient care at the VA, ways to create & keep good-paying jobs for physicians, and reduce barriers to treatment.

I will always get the backs of the healthcare workers who keep Jersey families healthy. https://t.co/VCeGLRLl0n

I’m glad to see that Bergen County clawed back to NJ $3 million from the Opioid Trust, which will help us fight this awful disease with more treatment, education, and outreach efforts.
 
We need to deploy every tool available to put a stop to this devastating epidemic.

I’m proud to work with @brianstacknj, @SenPresScutari, @MayorBollwage, and the Union County Commissioners to stop scammers from stealing families’ vital nutrition and assistance benefits.

Together, we'll stop heartless criminals and ensure Jersey families in need are protected. https://t.co/IB0TX6M8Ok

Each year, more than 60,000 Americans are diagnosed with blood cancers.

We must invest in research and treatment of blood cancers — and ensure those with cancer have the caregiving support they need. https://t.co/fyE53uXVfA

There’s nothing red or blue about feeding our children and educating the leaders of the future — it’s why school breakfast and lunch has always been a bipartisan issue.

It’s the right thing to do for our children’s health & wellness.

My prayers are with President Biden, Jill, and his entire family during this difficult time.

I wish him strength and a speedy recovery as he begins treatment.
